persona_and_vibe.concept: Fusion of Brutalist Tech and Immersive Gradient/3D
persona_and_vibe.description: A high-end, studio-grade portfolio for a 4th-year SWE specializing in AI/ML, AWS, and Web Dev. It combines the raw, stark, asymmetrical nature of Brutalism (stark black/white, raw grids, oversized typography) with the depth of Immersive 3D (deep space navy, glassmorphism, animated aurora blurs).
persona_and_vibe.emotion: Commanding, futuristic, highly technical yet intensely creative.

rules: NO full-screen flat gradients. Use Aurora colors as massive, heavily blurred (blur-[120px]) absolute divs behind the main content to create a deep space nebula effect.
Neon Lime is for strict interaction points ONLY (hover states, primary CTAs, active states, custom cursor dot). Do not overuse it.

scales.h1_hero: text-5xl sm:text-7xl md:text-8xl tracking-tighter uppercase font-black leading-none
scales.h2_section: text-4xl sm:text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tight uppercase font-bold

rules: Headings must NEVER be centered by default. Prioritize asymmetrical left or right optical alignment.
Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for high impact. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for numbers, dates, tech stacks, and labels.
Line height for headings must be tight (leading-none).

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento 'Tetris' Grid Protocol. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix tall, wide, and square spans to create visual tension.

surface_styles.glassmorphism: Used for sticky nav and floating overlay cards. backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0A0B10]/60 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]
surface_styles.brutalist_card: Used for Skills/Projects. bg-transparent border border-white/20 hover:border-[#CCFF00] transition-colors duration-300

motion_and_interaction.scroll: MANDATORY: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. It gives the site the weight and premium feel required for an Awwwards level site.
motion_and_interaction.cursor: Custom magnetic cursor using framer-motion. A small neon-lime dot that expands and applies mix-blend-mode: difference when hovering over text or images.
motion_and_interaction.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load. Wrap each word/line in an overflow-hidden div and translate Y from 100% to 0% using framer-motion staggerChildren.
motion_and_interaction.hover_effects: Magnetic buttons. Image clipping masks that slightly scale up (scale-105) inside an overflow-hidden container on hover.
motion_and_interaction.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for the tech stack using outline text (text-transparent stroke-white) or tiny mono text spaced generously (gap-24).

hero.details: Massive Cabinet Grotesk typography, masked line-by-line reveal. Deep space aurora blurs slowly shifting in the background. Sticky glassmorphism header with a 'Let's Talk' magnetic button.

about.details: Numbered manifesto chapters. Massive index numbers ('01', '02') in JetBrains Mono overlapping the body text. Left-aligned stark typography.

skills.details: Asymmetrical Bento grid with 1px border. Use the 'Tracing Beam' or subtle neon-lime glow on hover to highlight AI/ML, AWS, K8S, Java expertise.

projects.details: Large images inside clipped frames. Real imagery treated with a subtle grayscale filter that turns full color on hover. Parallax scroll effect inside the image container.

experience.details: Vertical timeline. A single 1px neon-lime line connecting nodes. Dates in JetBrains Mono. Hovering a node highlights the connecting line.

blog.details: Simple brutalist list format with bottom borders. Hovering over a row reveals a floating image tied to the custom cursor.

contact.details: Shadcn based working form. Strip standard UI look. Inputs should be brutalist (transparent bg, bottom 1px border only). Massive neon-lime submit button. Resume download link nearby.

components_styling.button: Pill-shaped for main CTAs, raw sharp rectangles for technical interactions. bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest hover:scale-105 transition-transform
components_styling.form_inputs: Use Shadcn/UI but override classes: bg-transparent border-0 border-b border-white/20 rounded-none focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-[#CCFF00]
components_styling.nav: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0B10]/60 border-b border-white/10

image_urls.description: Moody creative developer portrait in dark environment, perfect for the About manifesto section to establish a studio-grade persona.
Neon abstract data visualization to represent AI/ML projects and deep learning architecture.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure black and neon lime meet WCAG standards. Add text-shadow for text overlaid on aurora gradients.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button', data-testid='nav-about-link').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-transform, transition-colors).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding.
Implement micro-animations on every interaction (hover states, scroll reveals). Static = dead.
Use Phosphor Icons (duotone or regular) for sharp, premium UI elements.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; always use backdrop-blur + semi-transparent dark bg (e.g., bg-black/60).
NEVER use generic placeholder texts or dummy images where real visual storytelling is required.
CRITICAL: Do NOT output TypeScript (.tsx) files. Generate standard React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files.
Do NOT center align layouts universally. Asymmetry creates tension, and tension creates interest.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup standard React project with Tailwind. Do NOT use TypeScript.
2. Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lenis (or @studio-freight/react-lenis), @phosphor-icons/react, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge, sonner.
3. Configure Tailwind with custom fonts: 'Cabinet Grotesk' for display, 'Satoshi' for body, 'JetBrains Mono' for mono. Extend theme colors as defined in the guidelines.
4. Create a global Layout wrapper that initializes Lenis smooth scrolling and renders the custom Framer Motion cursor.
5. Build the Hero section with absolute blurred Aurora gradient divs in the background, and staggerChildren Framer Motion variants for the massive text reveal.
6. Assemble the Bento Grid for Skills using exact grid spans to ensure asymmetry.
7. Implement Shadcn-based contact form, override classes to brutalist style, and ensure working frontend state with Sonner toasts.
8. Apply data-testid to every single interactive element.
